label: has political or institutional leader
definition: Institution or political body X has person Y as president, leader or head, including legislative leadership.
scope_notes: Inverse of prior leader/office scope. General control by a party, legal representation and ordinary co-occurrence do not establish a named leadership office; a group argument standing for an unnamed leader requires review.

facts.reason: Simpson has Cochran as lawyer/counsel; legal representation is not institutional leadership.
Republicans control/hold Senate, but the leader-appos path may stand for an unnamed Republican officeholder rather than the whole party.
facts.reviewer_question: Does the leader construction identify a named individual omitted by the Republicans argument, or assert the party itself as institutional leader?

facts.reason: Senate has Mitchell as explicit leader in noun, possessive and of constructions.
Sears and Roebuck are linked only by an announce subject path, with no leader office.
Senate explicitly has Lott as leader, with additional whip and contextual paths.
